mapper.sql: POOLID, POOLCODE, POOLNAME, POOLTYPE, MASTERPOOLID, MASTERACCOUNTID, MASTERACCOUNTNUMBER, CURRENCYCODE, TOTALBALANCE, AVAILABLEBALANCE, RESERVEBALANCE, MINBALANCE, MAXBALANCE, POOLSTATUS, DESCRIPTION, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE MASTERACCOUNTID = #{masterAccountId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE MASTERPOOLID = #{masterPoolId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE MASTERPOOLID IS NULL AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE CURRENCYCODE = #{currencyCode} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE POOLTYPE = #{poolType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE POOLSTATUS = #{poolStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE POOLSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE MASTERPOOLID IS NULL AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY POOLCODE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN POOLSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN POOLSTATUS = 'INACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS inactiveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN POOLSTATUS = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 END) AS suspendedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN POOLSTATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS closedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MASTERPOOLID IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS masterPoolCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN MASTERPOOLID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS subPoolCount FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
SELECT POOLTYPE AS poolType, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTALBALANCE) AS totalBalance FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY POOLTYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT POOLSTATUS AS poolStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTALBALANCE) AS totalBalance FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY POOLSTATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CURRENCYCODE AS currencyCode, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(TOTALBALANCE) AS totalBalance, SUM(AVAILABLEBALANCE) AS availableBalance, SUM(RESERVEBALANCE) AS reserveBalance FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CURRENCYCODE ORDER BY totalBalance DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS SET TOTALBALANCE = #{totalBalance}, AVAILABLEBALANCE = #{availableBalance}, RESERVEBALANCE = #{reserveBalance}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{poolId}
UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS SET TOTALBALANCE = TOTALBALANCE + #{amount}, AVAILABLEBALANCE = AVAILABLEBALANCE + #{amount}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{poolId}

update.foreach: UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS SET TOTALBALANCE = #{item.totalBalance}, AVAILABLEBALANCE = #{item.availableBalance}, RESERVEBALANCE = #{item.reserveBalance}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{item.poolId}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND MINBALANCE IS NOT NULL AND TOTALBALANCE < MINBALANCE ORDER BY (MINBALANCE - TOTALBALANCE) DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND MAXBALANCE IS NOT NULL AND TOTALBALANCE > MAXBALANCE ORDER BY (TOTALBALANCE - MAXBALANCE) DESC

SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ( (MINBALANCE IS NOT NULL AND TOTALBALANCE < MINBALANCE) OR (MAXBALANCE IS NOT NULL AND TOTALBALANCE > MAXBALANCE) OR POOLSTATUS IN ('SUSPENDED', 'INACTIVE') ) ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND POOLSTATUS != 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND MAXBALANCE IS NOT NULL AND MAXBALANCE > 0 AND (TOTALBALANCE / MAXBALANCE * 100) > #{threshold} ORDER BY (TOTALBALANCE / MAXBALANCE) DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND POOLSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND AVAILABLEBALANCE > RESERVEBALANCE ORDER BY POOLCODE
SELECT FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND POOLSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (MAXBALANCE IS NULL OR TOTALBALANCE < MAXBALANCE) ORDER BY POOLCODE
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS fp SET TOTALBALANCE = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CURRENTBALANCE), 0) FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm WHERE fpm.POOLID = fp.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{poolId}

UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS fp SET TOTALBALANCE = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CURRENTBALANCE), 0) FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm WHERE fpm.POOLID = fp.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), AVAILABLEBALANCE = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CURRENTBALANCE), 0) - COALESCE(fp.RESERVEBALANCE, 0) FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm WHERE fpm.POOLID = fp.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{poolId}

update.foreach: UPDATE TBL_FUND_POOLS fp SET TOTALBALANCE = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CURRENTBALANCE), 0) FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm WHERE fpm.POOLID = fp.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), AVAILABLEBALANCE = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CURRENTBALANCE), 0) - COALESCE(fp.RESERVEBALANCE, 0) FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm WHERE fpm.POOLID = fp.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE POOLID = #{poolId}

mapper.select: SELECT fp.POOLID, fp.POOLCODE, fp.POOLNAME, fp.TOTALBALANCE AS poolTotalBalance, COALESCE(SUM(fpm.CURRENTBALANCE), 0) AS memberTotalBalance, ABS(fp.TOTALBALANCE - COALESCE(SUM(fpm.CURRENTBALANCE), 0)) AS balanceDifference FROM TBL_FUND_POOLS fp LEFT JOIN TBL_FUND_POOL_MEMBERS fpm ON fp.POOLID = fpm.POOLID AND fpm.MEMBERSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE fp.ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY fp.POOLID, fp.POOLCODE, fp.POOLNAME, fp.TOTALBALANCE HAVING ABS(fp.TOTALBALANCE - COALESCE(SUM(fpm.CURRENTBALANCE), 0)) > 0.01 ORDER BY balanceDifference DESC
SELECT CHANGEID, POOLID, FIELDNAME, OLDVALUE, NEWVALUE, CHANGEUSER, CHANGETIME FROM TBL_FUND_POOL_CHANGE_HISTORY WHERE POOLID = #{poolId} ORDER BY CHANGETIME DESC
